info.sub_name: 電腦輔助工程分析：電聲學

description.sub_name: 電腦輔助工程分析：電聲學
description.describe_ch: 本課程將以電聲領域為核心，搭配有限元素軟體COMSOLMultiphysics為分析工具，規劃從介面功能操作、電磁、力學、聲學與熱等物理特性模擬，擴展至多重物理域耦合，並以電聲產品為主，理論公式為輔，進而完成電聲產品特性之分析。
description.describe_eh: This course will focus on the Electroacoustics(EA) field and use the finite element software COMSOL Multiphysics as an analysis tool. All weekly lessons begin from the interface operations, electromagnetics, mechanics, acoustics, thermal, and expand to multi-physics domain coupling. Real EA products will be the main cases in this course. The related theoretical formulas will be also aided to interpret with the analysis results.

targets.describe_ch: 了解有限元素法理論與電腦數值模擬運算的基本觀念以及其應用於解決電聲領域問題的範疇
targets.describe_en: To understand the basic concepts of finite element method theory and computer numerical simulations as well as the application to solve the problems in the field of Electroacoustics.

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生了解 CAE 的分析架構以及如何因應工程問題進行模擬分析流程的規劃與執行
targets.describe_en: To cultivate CAE analysis framework and how to plan and execute the correct the simulation process in response to the engineering problems

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生具備應用CAE進而整合電聲工程知識與理論於電聲產品設計、分析和最佳化之能力
targets.describe_en: To cultivate the abilities of CAE to integrate the electroacoustic knowledge and theory into the product design, analysis, redesign, and optimization
